message.content:
I don’t have access to live data feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles at this moment. However, you can quickly check the current conditions on several reliable platforms:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow.gov** | Search “Los Angeles” → see the latest AQI and pollutant breakdown. |
| **EPA’s Air Quality Dashboard** | Enter ZIP code or city → view real‑time readings and forecasts. |
| **Weather apps (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather)** | Look for the “Air Quality” section; many include AQI values. |
| **Mobile apps (e.g., AQICN, Plume Labs)** | Download the app → set your location → get push notifications for changes. |

If you’re looking for historical trends or more detailed pollutant data, the EPA’s AirData portal lets you download daily reports for specific monitoring stations in LA.
